rdfs:label: endpoints
rdfs:comment: Container for additional service endpoints exposed by an ActivityPub actor (Person, Application, Group, Organization or Service) — most importantly `sharedInbox`, but also `proxyUrl`, OAuth endpoints, and others.
notes: Value is an Object whose properties are well-known endpoint names. The most-used in practice is `sharedInbox` (a single inbox URL serving multiple actors on the same server, used to deduplicate fan-out). Federated servers MAY deliver to `endpoints.sharedInbox` instead of each recipient's `inbox` when delivering the same Activity to many recipients on one server. Defined by ActivityPub, not the AS2 Vocabulary.
